text: S590 tests one distinct diagnostic mechanism based on S552's measured short incoming edges and repeated dropped vertices: radius-0.05 cm tangent fillets at only the five Polo CUT corners, in an exchange-only copy. First require an exact geometry delta within 0.001 cm; only then one clean-scene CLO DXF-AAMA exchange using pinned settings. No source, legacy writer, byte identity, gate or claim changes. See E-G04-S590-START.
